text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And just so there's no
misunderstanding...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If I were the type to throw in the towel
so easily, I
would never have come to
the academy in the
first place.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: 君と一緒に最後まで諦めないよ
貴方と一緒に最後まで諦めないから

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: 君と一緒に最後まで諦めないよ
貴方と一緒に最後まで諦めないから

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... No one said you have to go that
far.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But, very well. If we're making heartfelt
promises,
then you have my permission
to put forth your
utmost effort as my
trainer until the very end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
All so that this first-rate Umamusume
can obtain
a victory worthy of the name
King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're absolutely right. We don't
have
time to sit around moaning about
our failures.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You really do know just what to say

sometimes, don't you?
